notes.title: Milthm 3.8 Version Update
notes.notes:
Main Additions
1. Added 3 new original tracks to Main Story: Chapter 1. They can be unlocked by reading the "Epilogue" story section of "Main Story: Chapter 1".
2. Added a new track "LOUDER!" to Main Story: Prologue". Also, the track "Moving on" will be moved to "Singles: Dream Tape" pack.
3. Added new story sections for "Main Story: Chapter 1".
General Changes
1. [BREAK CHANGE] Modified the saving structure. After downloading v3.8, please do not use any version prior to v3.7 to load save files, as it can cause permanent save crashes.
2. [Android] Added settings for graphic backend selection.
3. Added the function of copying system information in one click in the game.
4. Fixed a bug where the game initialization process would be repeated when returning to the title screen in the game.
5. Fixed an issue where an initialization error could cause the app to get stuck on the Preparing screen.
6. Added French as a language option.
Gameplay changes
1. Added song searching function
2. Added random song selection function.
3. Different chapters will now use their own sorting settings.
4. Added the hit offset graph of the most recent play in the offset setting pages.
5. Added a new grade for charts that has a score of 1005000 and above.
6. Supported the function of sliding up and down on the right half of the screen on the song select UI.
7. Modified the sorting icon to distinguish the ascending / descending sorting order, and slightly adjusting the sorting logic.
8. Fixed the mismatch behavior between deduplication and storage on the audio setting.
9. Fixed the memory leak problem on song artworks.
10. Fixed the rendering issues of some notes.
11. Now, when the track title and artist are too long, the text will scroll when selected.
Visual novel changes
1. Added fast forward and dialogue history function.
2. The role tag "I" is now replaced with the user nickname.

notes.title: Milthm 3.0.0 Version Update
notes.notes:
New Additions to "Dream Tape" Songs:
- "Rainbow Flavor!" by SuggestedCopy7 & Ashur
- "IN" by Zris feat. Katie

Destructive/Structural Changes:
- Updated Unity Engine to 6000.0.28
- Introduced the UniTask coroutine library
- Updated various Native Dependencies

UI/UX:
- Improved game launch experience
- Fixed an issue where images on some launch pages might be misaligned on tablet devices
- Significantly reduced song-switching wait times in the song selection list, enhancing its smoothness
- Reduced unnecessary UI redraws to improve performance
- The song selection list now supports square song art
- Fixed incorrect positioning when switching tabs on the Settings page
- Slightly refined the design of the song selection interface

Miscellaneous:
- Fixed an issue where the special visual effects in "サイクルの欠片" could cause crashes or lag on some devices
- Added a prompt in the "Ripples of Dreams" interface to indicate disabled options when in main story mode or other special gameplay flows
- Adjusted some in-game text and translations

notes.title: Milthm 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
This update includes the addition of two songs in the music pack "Dream Tape":
* "WATER" by A-39 & 沙包P
* "Dogbite" by t+pazolite
Along with various bug fixes, detail optimizations, and feature additions:
* Added a anti-cheat system for drizzle notes.
* Introduced a judgment protection feature for raindrop notes.
* The "Dance" gameplay no longer hides statistical information.
* Added support for Korean and Russian languages.
* Enhanced Japanese language support, fixed translation errors in English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese.
* Added inference and reminder for touch interruptions during gameplay.
* Slightly reduced the intensity of anomalies for "雨之城" and "雨女".
* Included a game mechanism guide.
* Fine-tuned multiple charts.
* Fixed lag issues during game settlement moments.
* Optimized gameplay performance.
* Fixed crashes on certain iOS models.
* Optimized some user experience aspects.
* Fixed issues in the "Invisible" gameplay affected by note size settings and visibility problems for some notes in "Invisible" mode.
* Added a "90 FPS" option for frame rate settings.
* Differentiated the hitting sound effects for "Hard Style I" and "Hard Style II".
* Unlocked tracks will now display a lock icon next to the song title.
* Optimized installation package size.
